items.claim: Ian Garry is long, rangy, moves well, and is difficult to take down and hold down.
items.quote: He's long, rangy, moves really well. You don't often see him getting taken down and held there.

items.claim: Ian Garry is young, fresh, and does not have a lot of damage or miles on the clock.
items.quote: He's young, he's fresh, he's not had a, you know, loads of damage or anything like that. He's not got a lot of miles on the clock.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is exceptionally physically strong, which opponents frequently note.
items.quote: People are saying there's reports across the board that he's the strongest person that people have ever fought. Apparently, he's so physically strong

items.claim: Ian Garry needs to use his range, keep strikes long, and avoid putting his back on the fence against Islam.
items.quote: He has to be really aware of his awareness and his opponent's awareness in the octagon... I think very important that he doesn't put his own back on the fence.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is getting a little bit older but is still firmly in his prime.
items.quote: Islam Makhachev. He's getting a little bit older now. But he's still in his prime. He's definitely still in his prime
